accuracy.evidence: Definitions match the Year 1 programme of study (identify and name carnivores, herbivores, omnivores); diets checked: elephants and giraffes are plant eaters, domestic cats are obligate carnivores, bears, pigs and hens are omnivores, owls eat small mammals and insects.

misconceptions.evidence: Targets the documented slips: big or fierce means meat eater (elephant prediction and sort), small or cute means plant eater (cat prediction), omnivores forced into one group (bear, hen), and sorting by habitat or looks (reason step).

lab_distinct.evidence: flagdiet is built on feeding: a food dropped on the rabbit, cat or bear is accepted or refused by diet, then animals go into plant, meat or both bowls; no other lab models diet acceptance.

lab_teaches.evidence: The child finds out the rule by feeding before the word is given: the rabbit refuses fish, the cat refuses grass, the bear takes both, and the done message names herbivore, carnivore, omnivore.

predictions.evidence: Four predictions each have a tempting wrong option the lab disproves: a hungry rabbit eats fish, a soft cat eats grass, a big bear eats only meat, a hen is a herbivore.

challenge_feedback.evidence: Six Challenge questions with twelve specific slip messages, e.g. 'Big does not mean meat eater. Elephants eat only plants.' and 'Berries are plants, so a bear eats more than meat.'

readability.evidence: Kid text uses short sentences and the three key words each once with an example; adult notes use the exact Year 1 wording and stay within the family readability limit.

no_filler.evidence: Every kid paragraph gives a group with a named animal, the adult notes give curriculum, terms, four common mistakes and the lab plan; the family tip is a dinner-plate sort.

mobile.evidence: At 390 px the food row is five big tiles, the bowls fill the width in three columns, the animal card is drag-or-tap, and every action has a 56 px button twin under the canvas.

accessibility.evidence: Feeding, sorting and reason picks all have labelled buttons, the canvas aria-label is updated with every result, text sits on translucent tiles in theme text colour, and Show me respects reduced motion.
